content_sections.heading: CNP Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. CNP/HR/Consultant(Civil)-Contractual/04/2026 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download CNP notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Diploma/ Degree in Civil Engineering; retired Executive/Gazetted Officer from Government Department, State bodies, Autonomous bodies, PSU, etc. who served in CDA/IDA pay scales, with experience in construction and maintenance works of structure and buildings, Quarters, monitoring and execution of civil projects, and hands-on experience in the e-tendering process Experience: Retired Executives/ Gazetted Officer from Government Department, State bodies, Autonomous bodies, PSU, etc. who have served in CDA/IDA Pay scales, having experience in construction and maintenance Works of structure and buildings, Quarters, Monitoring and execution of civil projects and having hand-on experience in the e-tendering process Age limit: Below 64 years (as on 12 December 2026) Other conditions: Only retired Executives/ Gazetted Officers from Government Department, State bodies, Autonomous bodies, PSU, etc. who served in CDA/IDA pay scales Hands-on experience in the e-tendering process required Must not undertake any other full-time or part-time employment during the engagement

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for CNP Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Insolvency Pendency of investigation/ trial in relation to a criminal offence Conviction by Court of Law for criminal offence Dismissal/ termination from previous employment(s) pursuant to disciplinary action

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Consolidated Compensation (all inclusive) as per the level of the substantive post at the time of retirement. Initially 01 year from date of joining; may be reduced or extended at the discretion of the Unit; extension on performance basis Contract terminates automatically on attaining 65 years Management may terminate with 15 days' notice; appointee may leave with one month's notice or one month's compensation Paid leave of one day for every 20 days of work Mediclaim premium up to Rs.2 Lacs and accidental insurance premium for Rs.3 lacs reimbursed when engagement exceeds 6 months

content_sections.heading: How Will CNP Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview Walk-in interview from 09:00 AM to 01:00 PM on 12-12-2026

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form with recent passport size photo Original certificates with one set of self-attested Xerox copies (Date of Birth, Educational Qualifications, Experience) Aadhar Card as Identity Proof Copy of retirement order / VRS, last payment slip, appointment and promotion orders Supporting documents of level and designation at retirement in IDA / CDA / Pay Scale PPO copy, if applicable; experience certificates

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CNP Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill in the application form printed in the notice (pages 5-6), with a recent passport size photo not older than 06 months. Fill in the Annexure-A checklist of documents enclosed. Register at Pass Section, Currency Note Press, Nashik on 12-12-2026 between 09:00 AM and 12:00 PM. Bring original certificates with one set of self-attested Xerox copies and the Aadhar Card for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Absence other than authorised leave leads to pro-rata deduction from compensation Income tax will be deducted at source Appointee will not sign or certify documents, pass bills or supervise SPMCIL employees
